{{Quote|Thaal was an army colonel stationed here on Coruscant when the Yuuzhan Vong invasion came. Instead of evacuating, he volunteered to lead a unit of elites to set up on Vandor-Three.''"<br />"''Where?''"<br />"''It's actually here in the Coruscant system. The next planet sunward.|[[Myri Antilles]] and [[Viull Gorsat]]|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Vandor-3''', also spelled as '''Vandor-Three''',<ref name="Mercy Kill" /> was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Description==
{{Quote|Lightly populated by Coruscant standards. It has old links to the armed forces&mdash;back in the Clone Wars, there were clone trooper training grounds near Vangard, the capital. But now it's mostly agricultural, with a petroleum industry. It supplies Coruscant with a lot of its food and raw material for plastic products. Most people here consider Vandor-Three to be beyond the borders of civilization and culture. Like an uneducated cousin who doesn't bathe.|[[Myri Antilles]], to [[Viull Gorsat]]|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
Vandor-3 was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] with [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and a small population. Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] was a small industrial town that included a [[petroleum]] plant.

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|I've never been to Coruscant. Closest I ever came was training on one of the inner worlds of that system. You've been there?''"<br />"''Once. Before the start of the Outer Rim Sieges.|[[Climber (clone)|Climber]] and [[Salvo (clone trooper)|Salvo]]|<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
In [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]], the [[Tech Raiders]], a criminal organization that stole tech equipment and later sold them on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], relocated their base to Vandor-3.<ref name="TDH">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter]]''</ref>

Vandor-3 served as a training ground for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. For the training ground, a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] was constructed on the capital's outskirts that could hold 50,000 [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. One particular exercise involved facing the [[selenome]] that inhabited one of the planet's oceans.<ref name="TCD" />

===Later history===
{{Quote|When the final assault came here on Coruscant, he somehow persuaded his superiors to let him go to Vandor-Three and build a resistance cell there. Which he did pretty well. Those were his original Pop-Dogs, and he became a hero.|[[Zehrinne Thaal]], to [[Garik Loran]]|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Vandor-3 became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Vandor-3 joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and later its successor state, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].
